layout.arrangement: White slide enclosed by a thin red rectangular frame. Title centered at top. Yellow circular slide-number badge at top-right. Below the title, a full-width cream info panel with a blue border containing three stacked labeled sections (Input: / Output: / Remember:). The bottom third is a red-bordered white diagram panel: a left gutter holds two red labels; a top row of 8 small token boxes (Y's) with 5 blue ellipsis dots runs above a large navy banner reading 'Multi Head Self Attention Block'; a bottom row of 8 token boxes (X's) with 5 green ellipsis dots runs below the banner; blue up-arrows connect X row -> banner -> Y row; a yellow-highlighted caption sits centered at the panel's bottom. A thin black strip at the very bottom edge is a video-player artifact.

visual_elements.description: Info panel: light-cream rectangle with thin dark-blue border. Three stacked sections, each with a bold blue header at the left margin ('Input:', 'Output:', 'Remember:') and indented blue body lines; bracketed annotations sit on the same lines as body text, roughly column-aligned to the right of the body text.

Data-flow diagram of the attention block: (a) central navy rectangle with white bold text 'Multi Head Self Attention Block'; (b) top row of 8 small token boxes labeled Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, Y_5 [?], Y_6 [?], Y_{N/2} [?], Y_{N+1} [?], with 5 blue ellipsis dots between the 6th and 7th boxes; (c) bottom row of 8 token boxes labeled X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4, X_5 [?], X_6 [?], X_{N/2} [?], X_{N+1} [?], with 5 green ellipsis dots between the 6th and 7th boxes; (d) 8 blue block arrows pointing UP from the X boxes into the banner's bottom edge, and 8 blue block arrows pointing UP from the banner's top edge into the Y boxes (flow: X inputs up through block to Y outputs); (e) each token box is a small rectangle with a light-yellow upper cell and a pink lower cell, with a red bold subscripted label at its top; (f) yellow-highlighted caption 'Word  Embedding  +  Positional  Information' centered beneath the X row.
Slide-number badge: yellow filled circle containing the red bold number '36'.

recreation_brief: 1. Set a 16:9 white-background slide. 2. Draw a no-fill rectangle with a 2pt #CC0000 border, inset ~4% from every edge, as the outer frame. 3. Top-center text box: 'Multi Head Self Attention Block', Arial Bold 30pt, #CC0000, centered. 4. Top-right: 0.45in circle, fill #FFFF00 with thin red outline, text '36' in red bold 14pt, centered. 5. Info panel: rectangle at x=10%, y=20%, w=80%, h=42%, fill #FFFFE6, 2pt #0000CC border. Inside, left-aligned blue (#0000CC) ~16pt text with these lines: 'Input:' (bold); indented 'Word Embedding + Positional Information   [First Transformer Block]'; 'Output of Previous Transformer Block      [Stacked Transformer Blocks]'; blank line; 'Output:' (bold); indented 'Encoded Vectors of Input Sequence   [With Same Input Vectors Dimension]'; blank line; 'Remember:' (bold); indented 'Different Input Sequences should be of Same Length  (Fixed Length Sequences)'; further indented '[Apply  Pad or Cut]'; then 'Output Sequence is of same Length as Input Sequence'. 6. Diagram panel: rectangle x=7%, y=64%, w=86%, h=31%, white fill, 2pt #CC0000 border. 7. Left gutter: red bold 12pt labels 'Output of Self' / 'Attention' (two lines) at the panel's upper-left, and 'Input to Self' / 'Attention' (two lines) at the panel's lower-left. 8. Navy banner: rectangle x=17%, y=74%, w=75%, h=8.5%, fill #000080, centered white bold 18pt text 'Multi Head Self Attention Block'. 9. Build one token-box prototype: 0.55in x 0.30in, two stacked cells — top cell #FFFF99, bottom cell #FF99CC, thin gray outline — with a red bold subscripted label centered at its top. Duplicate 8 times across the top row with labels Y_1, Y_2, Y_3, Y_4, Y_5, Y_6, Y_{N/2}, Y_{N+1}, and 8 times across the bottom row with labels X_1, X_2, X_3, X_4, X_5, X_6, X_{N/2}, X_{N+1}; place the top row just above the banner and the bottom row just below it. 10. Between the 6th and 7th top-row boxes place 5 small (~0.07in) #0000CC circles in a horizontal line; between the 6th and 7th bottom-row boxes place 5 #00B050 circles. 11. Insert 16 blue (#0000FF) upward block arrows (~0.25in wide x 0.35in tall): 8 rising from each bottom token box into the banner's bottom edge, and 8 rising from the banner's top edge into each top token box. 12. Bottom-center of the panel: text 'Word  Embedding  +  Positional  Information', bold ~12pt, dark red (#990000), with a #FFFF00 text highlight. 13. Omit the black bottom strip and the mouse cursor (both are recording artifacts).
